model-viewer 4.3.1, official standalone dist/model-viewer.min.js bundle.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@google/model-viewer/-/model-viewer-4.3.1.tgz
SHA256: 283b0672384614b4847636c306fc93fe4b1fcadc76d668b4e47f0ca76bcf033b
License: Apache-2.0; see model-viewer-LICENSE.txt and preserved dependency notices.

This self-contained bundle includes its compatible Three.js revision 183.
The gallery itself retains Three.js 0.185.1. The viewer is loaded only when
the visitor opens an artwork's AR preview. Standard GLB/JPEG assets require
no optional Draco, KTX2 or Lottie downloads.
